Calibration of Geomorphon Parameters Against Reference Targets

Source: R/calibrate.R
geomorphon_calibrate.Rd

Evaluates spatial concordance between multiple runs of a geomorphon_sweep() and reference categorical target raster layers. Combines sweep parameter metadata with concordance metrics, boundary-density penalties, and Pareto-optimal frontier identification.

Usage

geomorphon_calibrate(
  sweep_obj,
  targets,
  forms = NULL,
  method = c("both", "nmi", "boundary"),
  threshold_cells = 2,
  spatial_null = TRUE
)

Arguments

sweep_obj

An object of class geomorphon_sweep.

targets

A single- or multi-layer categorical SpatRaster representing reference classification targets (e.g. from geomorphon_targets()).

forms

Character vector of form taxonomies to evaluate (e.g. c("forms10", "forms6")). Default is NULL, which evaluates all taxonomies found in sweep_obj.

method

Character concordance method: "both" (default), "nmi", or "boundary". Passed to geomorphon_concordance().

threshold_cells

Integer or numeric cell distance tolerance for boundary metrics. Default is 2.

spatial_null

Logical. Whether to evaluate spatial-null circular shift ensembles in geomorphon_concordance(). Default is TRUE.

Value

A tidy data.frame combining sweep parameter columns (run_id, search, skip, flat_angle_deg, dist, comparison_mode, tdist, resolution, elapsed_sec, n_cells), forms, target, concordance metrics, edge_ratio, density_penalty, is_pareto, and pareto_score.

Examples

library(terra)
data(salton, package = "rgeomorphon")
dem <- rast(salton)
crs(dem) <- attr(salton, "crs")
ext(dem) <- attr(salton, "extent")
sw <- geomorphon_sweep(dem, param_grid = list(search = c(3, 4)), forms = "forms6")
cat_rast <- (dem > 50) + 1
levels(cat_rast) <- data.frame(id = 1:2, category = c("Low", "High"))
names(cat_rast) <- "elevation_class"
cal <- geomorphon_calibrate(sw, targets = cat_rast, spatial_null = FALSE)
print(cal)
#>   run_id search skip flat_angle_deg dist comparison_mode tdist resolution
#> 1      1      3    0              1    0         anglev1     0        300
#> 2      2      4    0              1    0         anglev1     0        300
#>   elapsed_sec n_cells  forms          target nmi homogeneity completeness
#> 1       0.028   26565 forms6 elevation_class   0          NA            0
#> 2       0.026   26565 forms6 elevation_class   0          NA            0
#>   n_edges_geo n_edges_cat edge_ratio density_penalty edge_offset
#> 1         858           0         NA              NA          NA
#> 2         903           0         NA              NA          NA
#>   edge_concordance edge_f1 edge_mhd edge_chamfer mean_null_nmi delta_nmi
#> 1               NA      NA       NA           NA            NA        NA
#> 2               NA      NA       NA           NA            NA        NA
#>   nmi_null_shifts mean_null_edge_f1 delta_edge_f1 edge_f1_null_shifts
#> 1               0                NA            NA                   0
#> 2               0                NA            NA                   0
#>   null_shifts_evaluated is_pareto pareto_score
#> 1                     0      TRUE            1
#> 2                     0      TRUE            1
